text:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — Acme Xpress asked to onboard a custom 13B (fine-tuned) into Private with HSM + dedicated capacity. They flagged PHI, <50ms p50 target, and annual renewal coming up — want a readiness plan by EOD Friday.

Josh (Solutions): Got it. Do we have their model artifact format + quantization requirements? need to know if it's `ggml`, `pt` or an ONNX flavor. Also: expected max seq len?

Maria (CS): They've submitted `model.tar.gz` (custom fine-tune) and a short spec: seq_len 2048, float16, no quantization applied. They asked for recommendations for int8/4 quant to hit latency goals.

Anya (T&S): PHI + healthcare claims — we need an ingestion/data handling plan, eval dataset, and safety tests. Can the customer provide a redacted validation set for regression checks? We should require a safety checklist signed before private deploy. :exclamation:

Priya (Ops): I'll calendar a pre-onboard call. Suggest pairing infra + cs + t&s. Timeline: collect artifacts by Wed, run compatibility + smoke evals Thu, run safety/regression Friday. Is that tight for you all?

Josh (Solutions): Tight but doable. I want to run a quick local perf pass with their artifact. If quant recommended, we should test 4-bit QAT vs GPTQ tradeoffs. Also need to confirm HSM key import format for model encryption at rest.

Sam (AM): Flagging renewal risk: Acme Xpress is near an upsell. If onboarding stalls >2 weeks we lose renewal momentum. Can we prioritize a canary path (limited preprod on Dedicated) to show value fast?

Maria (CS): Good call. Customer is OK with a short canary on Dedicated before full Private. That buys us time. Priya — can you scope a canary plan and cost estimate?

Priya (Ops): Will do. Draft canary plan: 2-week dedicated pool (2x A10G equiv), sample traffic, telemetry hooks. Need sign-off on SLA deviations and billing.

Anya (T&S): From safety side — minimal evals we need: (1) PHI leakage scan, (2) hallucination/regression on 500 QA pairs, (3) toxicity probe, (4) prompt injection tests. Please share expected pass thresholds.

Josh (Solutions): I'll push a quick eval config to run on their validation set. Snippet: 
```
model_id: acme-13b-v1
batch_size: 8
quant_modes: [none, int8, int4_gptq]
perf_targets: {p50_ms: 50}
eval_sets: [acme_redacted_val_v1.json]
```

Maria (CS): I've asked Acme for the redacted set and a list of sensitive fields. Also requested contact for their security lead.

DeployBot: Meeting scheduled: "Acme Xpress pre-onboard" — Wed 10:00 UTC. Invite: ops+solutions+t&s+cs.

Sam (AM): Can we include an enablement checklist for their engineering team? quick runbook for inference SDK, key rotation, and incident contacts. That will help with renewal conversation.

Priya (Ops): Adding enablement doc to agenda. I'll attach a draft before the call: https://internal.redwood/docs/onboard-templates (will post link in thread).

Anya (T&S): One more — enforce a gated rollout: canary -> staged -> private GA. Add automatic fallback to hosted model if safety or perf regressions are detected.

Maria (CS): Action items: Josh runs compatibility/perf + quant experiments (due Thu EOD), Anya drafts safety checklist + thresholds (Thu noon), Priya scopes canary + cost + runbook (Wed before call), Sam preps renewal talking points. I'll consolidate and send to Acme after Wed call.

Josh (Solutions): Acknowledged. Will post early perf logs here once first run completes. :thumbsup:

Maria (CS): Thanks team — this is high priority for account health. Will update thread after Wed meeting.
